test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six persons Akash, Naman, Divya, Rakesh, Pankaj and Ramesh are sitting in two parallel rows such that three are sitting in each row facing each other. Akash is facing Naman who is to the immediate left of Divya. Divya is sitting opposite of Ramesh who is facing south direction. Pankaj is sitting to immediate left of Ramesh. Who among them is facing north and not sitting in either corner?
solution:
Six persons Akash, Naman, Divya, Rakesh, Pankaj and Ramesh are sitting in two parallel rows such that three are sitting in each row facing each other. 

1) Akash is facing Naman who is to the immediate left of Divya.
